title: Review (Supported): on fresh seed 7 the catalyst-free FCH bodies again live on the unclipped decay term (6 bodies, ~751 amphiphile constant t=595-1200, bath u+1 -0.021, domain total 0) and die by t~746 once the decay is clipped at u=-1
summary: labkit runs of c17's world_noK.py (the claim's no-catalyst world, unchanged) and world_noK_clip.py (decay clipped at u=-1) on seed 7 to T=1200, measured with c17's mass.py. As coded: 6 bodies at every sample, body amphiphile 1506 -> 830 -> 767 -> 752 (t=141-595) then 751 +- 1 to t=1200, bath mean u+1 -0.017 -> -0.021, domain total u+1 916 -> 0.0. The inflow kap x 0.021 x ~36000 bath pixels ~ 7.6 per unit time matches the bodies' own decay kap x 751 ~ 7.5. Clipped: 6 bodies at t=141 and 292, 2 at t=444 and 595, 0 from t=746 on (bath falls to u+1 -0.042). The decay term is a hidden source below u=-1, as the finding says.

observations.E: mass_s7.txt: as coded 6 bodies hold 751 amphiphile constant t=595-1200 with K=0 and bath u+1 -0.021; clipped: 0 bodies from t=746 (negative result on the claimed E control replicated)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; I did not rerun the kb=0.05 arm. In the clipped world the domain total u+1 goes negative (-1546), because the bath relaxes further below -1 without the source; the clipped world is a diagnostic, not a corrected chemoton.
